purpose: prioritize reliability without hiding customer failures
normal: changes follow the normal review and rollout policy
exhausted: pause discretionary releases, prioritize reliability work and review the causes
exceptions: mitigation or fix for the active failure
exceptionApproval: service owner + incident lead, with reason and rollback plan recorded
dataIncomplete: investigate missing telemetry; do not classify the period as compliant
recovery: return through review when the agreed window meets the objective and mitigation is checked
